title: tissue holder
text: tissue holder. This holder appears to be resin, but in fact is actually painted/coated metal.  The edges are all smooth and rounded.  The bottom is open.  VERY easy to install the upright tissue box.  I chose the white.  It is a soft white, not a bright white.  Works exactly as it should.  It's weighty and feels like it will last a long time, however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
